noroeste.titulo_destaque: a new standard of living in Brasília.
noroeste.subtitulo: A Private selection of homes in the most sought-after neighborhood of Brasília's Plano Piloto.
noroeste.intro_titulo: One of the most valued and best-planned neighborhoods in the Plano Piloto
intro: Noroeste brings together contemporary architecture, green areas and strategic mobility, with easy access to the city's main axes, all within the Plano Piloto, Brasília's modernist core and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
With an established residential profile and strong demand, the neighborhood offers homes that combine quality of life, comfort and long-term appreciation potential.
diferenciais: Designed from scratch, with green areas, bike paths and infrastructure built for contemporary living.
Signature projects, striking façades and generous floor plans, in tune with Brasília's modernism.
Parks, neighborhood shops and a calm pace, minutes away from the city's central axes.
An increasingly scarce supply, with demand that remains high.

quadra-500.subtitulo: A Private selection of homes on the last strip of Sudoeste, facing the green.
quadra-500.intro_titulo: Where Brasília has already proven its value
intro: Quadra 500 in Sudoeste is one of the most refined movements in Brasília's luxury market: a rare, low-density address for those who value space, privacy and real quality of life.

Located on the last strip of Sudoeste, facing Sucupiras Park, Quadra 500 offers what cannot be replicated: open views of nature, little urban interference and a distinguished residential atmosphere. Generous floor plans, few units per building and high construction standards make it a wealth decision for those who know that exclusivity, location and scarcity are the true drivers of long-term value.
diferenciais: The last strip of the neighborhood, with low density and few units per project.
A monitoring center that watches over the area day and night.
Facing Sucupiras Park, with open views of the green.
Scarce land and high construction standards sustain long-term value.

numeros_noroeste.destaque: Noroeste has already sold 94% of everything launched.
itens: In the first half of 2026, Noroeste led new home sales in the Federal District:
402 units, up 44% on the previous period.

yard.chamada: Ready to move in, from the ground floor to the penthouse.
descricao: A premium development in Noroeste, with contemporary architecture and floor plans designed to make life flow naturally. Three-bedroom apartments and duplex penthouses, focused on comfort, performance and high-end finishes.

From the ground floor to the rooftop, leisure areas serve different moments of the day and are delivered fully equipped and furnished. The façade is clad entirely in granite, and the project brings together signature architecture, interiors and landscaping.
yard.nota: Granite façade and common areas delivered fully equipped and furnished.

azzure.chamada: Four suites, two balconies and natural light in every room.
descricao: Azzure is a premium, contemporary development in the heart of Noroeste, designed to take residential living to a new level of comfort, spaciousness and exclusivity.

With intelligent architecture and impeccable floor plans, every detail ensures cross ventilation, abundant natural light and fluid flow between rooms. The project offers only high-end units with 4 suites and two balconies.
azzure.nota: Every unit runs front to back, for maximum ventilation, privacy and comfort.

singular.chamada: Live in Noroeste without waiting for construction.
descricao: Singular Noroeste, by Soltec Engenharia, stands on one of the most valued blocks in Noroeste, next to Burle Marx Park. With contemporary architecture and generous floor plans, it was designed for comfort, privacy and quality of life, with natural light, cross ventilation and integrated living spaces.
Leisure is complete: swimming pool, spa, gym, party room, gourmet area and lounges, in a refined residential project that is ready to move in.
singular.nota: Next to Burle Marx Park, with complete leisure areas and ready to move in.

season.chamada: One of the last ready units in a neighborhood that is almost sold out.
descricao: Season Noroeste is a top-tier development in the heart of SQNW 304, one of the most valued blocks in Noroeste. Designed by Dávila Arquitetura, it combines elegance, comfort and functionality, with an imposing façade in granite, laminated glass and stainless-finish aluminum.
Common areas designed by Márcia Bizzi include a heated rooftop pool, barbecue and gourmet area, plus a playroom, game room, gym and gourmet lounge on the ground floor.
season.nota: Floor plans designed for thermal comfort, natural ventilation and integrated spaces.

descricao: Amaze Sunside, by Villela & Carvalho, is a contemporary development in Noroeste designed for a dynamic, urban lifestyle. Modern lines and smart design bring together studios and compact apartments for those who value practicality, technology and appreciation.
To live in or invest, Amaze combines functional floor plans with complete leisure and convenience: equipped gym, gourmet lounge, social areas and modern security and automation systems.
amaze-sunside.nota: Contemporary living in Noroeste, with strong appreciation potential.

biome.chamada: Live close to nature, at home in well-being.
descricao: Biome Studios is the first sustainable luxury development in Upper Noroeste, facing Burle Marx Park. Built by Villela & Carvalho, a pioneer of high-end studios in the neighborhood, it brings together 104 studios and 1- and 2-bedroom apartments in two towers, with architecture by Crosara, interiors by Bizzi Arquitetura and landscaping by Fábio Camargo.

The condominium is designed for efficiency: a rooftop solar plant sized for the common areas’ consumption, greywater treatment for irrigation and a single reception with facial access control. Amenities include a gym equipped by Matrix, a gourmet space with Le Creuset cookware, laundry, bike storage and a delivery room. On the ground floor, a gallery of boutique shops completes the concept.
biome.nota: 54 kWp solar plant for the common areas, greywater reuse and parking with electric-car charging infrastructure.

icon.chamada: Where greenery stops being scenery and becomes architecture.
descricao: Icon is the first development in the Base Genius Loci collection, the highest category of projects by Base Incorporações. It is built on one idea: architecture should start from the spirit of the place. In Brasília, that means celebrating the sky, the greenery and the open space. The façade is biophilic, with vegetation integrated into the building, and the pilotis free up the ground floor.

Just 40 four-suite apartments across 6 floors plus a rooftop level, open to natural light and to the unobstructed views only Brasília offers. Generous floor plans, finishes above market standard and a gym fully equipped by Technogym, minutes away from the seat of government and connected to the Monumental Axis.
icon.nota: Only 40 units, with a biophilic façade and a gym equipped by Technogym.
